    ShiftInvariant (Set.univ : Set (ℤ → A)) ∧

      ∀ t ∈ slideBlockCode m f '' S, ∃ s ∈ S, slideBlockCode m f s = t) :=
  paper_Phi_m_factor_on_subshift
